name: Society for the Promotion of Christian Knowledge, The
title: Society for the Promotion of Christian Knowledge, The
---

This charity, founded to promote Christianity at home and abroad in 1698, has long had and still has a substantial publishing arm. CMY planned to get it to publish a series of county histories (3, 5 November 1860).

Unlike many of her friends, she did not write for it.

Its archives are held in Cambridge University Library.

See http://www.spck.org.uk/about-spck/archives/
